svg.title: The March 29 run from above
svg.desc: Top-down paths in the motion capture frame. While the robot drives back and forth, ArduPilot's estimate (orange) follows the true path from motion capture (blue) to within 0.73 meters. When the robot starts to spin in place, the estimate (dashed) slides 0.6 meters away in 15 seconds, on its way to 155 meters, while the true position barely moves.
svg.text: 15 s later, still running away (peak 155 m)
